understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to solve each KA59 level by getting every selectable piece onto the goal tiles marked with '+'. If a level had multiple '+' tiles, all of them needed to be occupied by selectable pieces at the same time to trigger WIN, and then continue until the final run reports WIN for the whole game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn I could take an action (primarily CLICK) on a target grid coordinate. Clicking selected a piece (when applicable) and attempted to move the currently selected piece toward/onto the clicked tile according to the game’s movement rules. Movement was constrained by obstacles/walls/blocked tiles; if the destination or path was blocked the piece would not move (as happened repeatedly when clicking [35,17]). Pieces could be moved back and forth between reachable tiles (e.g., toggling between [12,21] and [21,21]). Actions consumed a limited step budget per level; when steps reached 0 the run ended regardless of progress. If the game supported pushing, it would occur only when a move direction caused contact with a pushable object and the push chain had free space; otherwise the move would be blocked.
